name: dynamite-place-wall
description: D-148 (user 2026-11-21 12:25: placed from the outer side of a half-mined copper deposit, the stick ended on its inner wall): with a stone wall 0.9 m in front, the stick is set down in FRONT of it on the ground the player stands on (never in or behind it); without the wall it goes the usual 1.2 m out, on the ground.

steps.name: GunPowdered.dynamitePlaceAt
steps.label: nothing in the way: set down

steps.name: GunPowdered.stickFromPlayer
steps.regex: ahead 1\.[0-2]\d m, up -?0\.[0-2]\d m, wall none
steps.label: the usual 1.2 m out, on the ground (within 0.3 m of the feet height)

steps.name: GunPowdered.dynamiteRemoveSticks
steps.label: the stick is taken away again

steps.name: GunPowdered.wallAhead
steps.label: a stone wall 0.9 m in front

steps.name: GunPowdered.dynamitePlaceAt
steps.label: the attack sets a stick down

steps.name: GunPowdered.stickFromPlayer
steps.regex: ahead 0\.[3-6]\d m, up -?0\.[0-2]\d m, wall 0\.9\d m ahead
steps.label: D-148: in front of the wall (0.3-0.7 m out, not at or past 0.9 m), on the ground

steps.name: GunPowdered.dynamiteRemoveSticks
steps.label: the sticks are taken away (the next test counts sticks)
